name: West African peanut stew with chicken
steps: Brown the diced chicken thigh in oil, then set aside.
Soften the onion, garlic, and ginger in the same pot.
Stir in the peanut butter, tomato paste, and a little water into a smooth sauce.
Return the chicken, add the sweet potato, and pour in stock to cover.
Simmer until the sweet potato is tender and the sauce thickens.
Stir the spinach through until wilted and season to taste.
